name: UpdateMediaWorkflow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media workflow that you want to update. To obtain the ID of the media workflow, you can log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console and choose Workflows > Workflow Settings in the left-side navigation pane
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的媒体工作流ID，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_id

parameters.help_en:
The new topology of the media workflow. The value is a JSON object that contains the activity list and activity dependencies.

The Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket must reside in the same region as your MPS service
parameters.help_zh:
更新的媒体工作流拓扑结构。JSON对象，包括活动列表及活动依赖。 

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: topology

parameters.help_en:
The media workflow Name.

Cannot Be Empty.
The workflow Name must be unique within the same Account.
Must not exceed 64 characters.
UTF-8 encoding
parameters.help_zh:
媒体工作流名称。

不能为空串。
同一账号下的工作流名称不可重复。
不超过 64 个字符。
UTF-8 编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The trigger mode. Valid values:
OssAutoTrigger: Automatically triggered.
NotInAuto: Not automatically triggered
parameters.help_zh:
触发模式。 取值：
OssAutoTrigger：自动触- 发。
NotInAuto：不自动触发
parameters.name: trigger_mode

MediaWorkflow.description_en: The detailed information about the media workflow

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the media workflow was created

MediaWorkflowId.description_en: The ID of the media workflow that is updated

Name.description_en: The name of the media workflow

State.description_en:
The state of the media workflow. Valid values:

Inactive: The media workflow is disabled.
Active: The media workflow is enabled
State.description_zh:
媒体工作流状态。可取值：

Inactive：已停用。

Active：已启用

Topology.description_en: The topology of the media workflow

TriggerMode.description_en:
The trigger mode of the media workflow. Valid values:

OssAutoTrigger: The media workflow is automatically triggered.
NotInAuto: The media workflow is not automatically triggered
TriggerMode.description_zh:
触发模式。可取值：
